name: mentat
description: Transcript-intelligence suite for Claude Code sessions. Ingests a session by id or transcript path, parses the real JSONL schema, and analyzes across dimensions — reliability (loops, tool/runtime + API errors, anti-patterns, context pressure), security (secrets in tool I/O, dangerous commands, prompt injection, exfiltration — always redacted, CI-gatable), and efficiency (real token spend, redundant work, cost). Every finding carries a stable fingerprint for cross-session dedup, feeding a local corpus that surfaces recurring-failure trends and proposes durable fixes. Negotiates a non-destructive fix contract (analyze, recommend, propose, apply) and includes a live transcript monitor for agent-to-agent feedback plus version-matched doc refresh.
